reason: I'd try the free tier, maybe. But I don't want an unknown app with access to my channel, and I'm not paying ₹299 a month for something I haven't seen work on my own numbers yet.
objection: I don't know who is behind this or what it does with my channel data. Read-only sounds fine on paper, but I've seen plenty of tools promise that and then ask for more.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it work on my own channel for free first, with a clear result that beat my usual views, plus creators I already follow vouching for it in Hindi.
